briefdescription.para: Returns the dark palette. Used for C++ property defaults.
A named set of theme colors shared by QML (via the Colors singleton) and C++ defaults.

detaileddescription.para: This is the single source of truth for QAccelPlot's color theme. C++ property defaults use ColorPalette::dark(); QML accesses both palettes as Colors.light and Colors.dark. All properties are read-only.
